data.name: The Fallen Lamb
data.detailed_description:
The Fallen Lamb is a dynamic Action RPG with a heavy roguelike twist. With multiple randomness-driven systems, every run is different: the challenges, rewards, and the path you take keep changing.

Gather upgrades, combine abilities, take risky decisions, and watch yourself grow stronger with every attempt until you become a ruthless killing machine. But remember: every power has its price, and your choices don’t disappear without a trace.

In the end, the moment of reckoning will come. Your soul will be placed on the scales — before God.

data.short_description: The Fallen Lamb is a dynamic Action RPG with a strong rogue-like core. Every run is different thanks to randomness, and your choices and skills gradually turn you into a killing machine. Remember: in the end, your soul will be weighed on God’s scales.

pc_requirements.minimum:

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains stylized violence (combat against enemies). It also includes alcohol use: an “alcohol bottle” item that triggers a brief intoxication effect (screen wobble/distortion). Additionally, the game features a scratch-off ticket with a random outcome (simulated gambling-like mechanics). The game does not contain sexual content or nudity.
